description: Lists all intents in a Cognigy.AI flow. Intents are the NLU triggers that match user utterances to flow logic. Use this to explore NLU configuration before training or modifying intents.

flowId.description: The flow ID to list intents from

includeChildren.description: Include child intents in the results

limit.description: Maximum number of intents to return (1-100, default 25)

localeId.description: Optional locale ID for localized content

name: list_intents
